title: Flox seeks $10 million to scale its wildlife AI devices
teaser: Flox Intelligence is building wildlife deterrence for places where roads, railways and airports meet unpredictable animal behavior. Its devices identify nearby species and play sounds intended to drive them away, rather than relying on a louder siren or a fixed signal. The company says about 150 devices are already operating across North America, Europe and Australia. Now it is opening a $10 million Series A to expand that fleet to several thousand and adapt its system for uses beyond wildlife protection.
